alerts.title: Iran war live: Iran says US ‘not serious’ about talks; ship ablaze off Iraq
alerts.why: Ship ablaze off Iraq and stalled US-Iran talks raise Middle East supply disruption fears, lifting Brent crude.

alerts.title: As Attacks Mount, Shipping Faces an Uncomfortable Question: Are Safety Rules Fit for War?
alerts.why: Record merchant ship attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and oil washing ashore signal severe supply disruption risks in a key chokepoint.

alerts.title: RT @cym27s : The IRGC says an oil tanker carrying over 2 million barrels of crude oil struck a naval mine while attempting to cross the Strait of Hormuz through an unauthorized route, causing a major
alerts.why: An oil tanker striking a naval mine near the Strait of Hormuz raises significant geopolitical supply disruption risks.

itemsSent.title: Oil prices fall as Saudi defense minister travels to Iran for talks to de-escalate conflict
itemsSent.why: Geopolitical de-escalation reduces the risk premium associated with Middle Eastern supply disruptions, putting downward pressure on crude prices.

itemsSent.title: Intercepted Houthi missiles cause damage in Saudi Arabian city
itemsSent.why: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East increase risk premiums, though no direct impact on Saudi oil infrastructure is reported.

itemsSent.title: The Fed is expected to hold rates steady Wednesday, but it is a closer call on the data than the market-implied probabilities suggest.
itemsSent.why: Market is already pricing in a hold; uncertainty regarding future rate paths creates volatility but lacks a clear directional catalyst for oil.

itemsSent.title: India’s BPCL to Cut Russian Oil Imports Due to Higher Prices
itemsSent.why: BPCL reducing Russian oil for Middle Eastern grades increases Middle East crude demand while freeing up discounted Urals, having mixed regional impacts.

itemsSent.title: Russian Refiners Ramp Up Diesel Output to Supply Trump Deal
itemsSent.why: Increased Russian diesel output and export quotas boost global supply, exerting downward pressure on diesel and heating oil prices.

itemsSent.title: Brent oil tops $117 as Saudi defense minister travels to Iran for talks to de-escalate conflict
itemsSent.why: Brent topped $117 amid Saudi-Iran talks, but prices fell as demand destruction fears offset infrastructure threat concerns.

itemsSent.title: Oil ticks lower as Saudi defense minister travels to Iran for talks to de-escalate conflict
itemsSent.why: Saudi-Iran de-escalation talks reduce geopolitical risk premiums, easing supply disruption fears and pushing crude prices lower.

itemsSent.title: The Iran War Just Added $39 Billion to the World's LNG Bill
itemsSent.why: Middle East conflict and Strait of Hormuz disruptions drive up global LNG spot prices and import costs.

itemsSent.title: Iran Threatens the Hormuz Internet Cables: Four Gulf States Have No Subsea Route That Avoids the Strait
itemsSent.why: Threats to Strait of Hormuz infrastructure raise geopolitical risk premiums for crude, though impact remains limited until physical disruption occurs.

itemsSent.title: Beijing Pushes Domestic Oil Production as Iranian Supply Dries Up
itemsSent.why: China pushing domestic oil production offsets falling Iranian supply, leaving near-term global balances largely neutral despite geopolitical tensions.
